Olmsted Deep Research Agent Skill – Stop Wasting Hours on Google: Olmsted Autonomous Deep Research

Instead of opening 40 browser tabs and manually sifting through sponsored search results, Olmsted's Deep Research Skill autonomously queries scientific papers, cross-references sources, and writes executive briefs.

Built for knowledge workers, tech operators, and fast-paced teams, Olmsted Deep Research Agent Skill removes administrative bottlenecks, automates high-frequency routines, and maximizes daily output.

Key Features:
• Install the Olmsted research skill into your agent workspace.
• Issue the research topic prompt in your terminal.
• Review the structured analytical dossier complete with direct DOI citations.
• Comprehensive 8-section research brief summarizing 14 peer-reviewed battery chemistry papers.

GitHub Repository: https://github.com/
Instagram Breakdown: https://www.instagram.com/p/DZScO7TtRkC/
